title: fix(app-shell): a navigation visible gate withholds its entry when it cannot be evaluated (objectui#12700)
body:
Part of #12700
Clause-②: yes

The `yes` is measured: `@object-ui/react` widens its published `PredicateGateKind` union by one member, `'withholding'`. No runtime signature moves; `@object-ui/app-shell`'s published `evaluateVisibility` is unchanged.

## Root cause (measured)

The card read the console warning as "the nav predicate reaches the engine without `permissions`". Two measurements, on objectui main `f8267df93`:

1. **Inside an app the gate already works.** The console mounts `MePermissionsProvider` around `/apps/:appName/*` only (`apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx`), and it renders its loading fallback, not the shell, until `/auth/me/permissions` answers. Under it, `ExpressionProvider` binds the `objects` map for `current_user.can`. A probe through `useNavMemberGates` with the served CEL envelope answered: denied → hidden, granted → shown, no warning. So the A1 assumption ("the nav predicate is evaluated before the payload loads") is false for the in-app sidebar: there is no loading window there.
2. **The warning comes from frames with no permission source at all.** `/home` (and the Studio frames) mount neither `MePermissionsProvider` nor `ExpressionProvider`. On `/home`, `AppHeader`'s bell (`useSharedActivityFeed`) and Home's activity card (`useHumanActivityFeed`) derive their activity roster from every app's navigation through `useNavMemberGates`, so HotCRM's `current_user.can("crm_opportunity", "read")` is evaluated by the no-provider default evaluator: the engine refuses ("this evaluation context carries no permission data"), and `evaluateVisibility` answered the refusal fail-open, i.e. "shown". That is the warning the card quotes, and it fires on every console load because the console lands on `/home`.

The A1 half that holds: the safe default for `app-shell:visible` was "show" (`evaluateVisibility` is fail-open).

## What this PR changes (ruling Target 2)

- New `evaluateNavigationVisibility` in `ExpressionProvider.tsx` (package-internal, not on the entry). Same verdict as `evaluateVisibility` for every predicate that evaluates; on a **fault** it withholds the entry and reports once per predicate with the engine's reason. A blank gate stays "no gate" and is drawn: a fault reported by the fail-soft call is confirmed on the evaluator's own fail-closed seam (`throwOnError`) before the entry is withheld, so a predicate that evaluates never pays a second call.
- The navigation surfaces use it: `useNavMemberGates` (sidebar, app-root landing, `SidebarItemMenu`, activity roster), the `nav:menu` block, and the command palette's navigation list.
- `evaluateVisibility` keeps its fail-open answer for the object-field gate (`isObjectFieldVisible`) and the published export.
- `visibilityDiagnostic.ts`: one new consequence row, `withholding`, because the existing `visibility` row ("the gate did NOT bite … reads like one that said yes") would now be false for a navigation entry. Same opening line, so filters on `UNRESOLVABLE_VISIBILITY_PREFIX` still catch it. The comment above the re-export in `packages/react/src/index.ts` stated the member count, so it now points at the union instead.
- No engine change, no server call, nothing about the server is claimed: this is UI gating, the server enforces reads.

## What this PR does NOT do (why `Part of`)

Target 1 for the `/home` and Studio frames is not reachable inside the claimed file surface: the only permission source the console has is the `MePermissionsProvider` that `apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx` mounts for `/apps/:appName/*`. With this PR those frames withhold a `can()`-gated entry from the activity roster (the safe direction), and the refusal is still reported once there, so the card's "console warning is gone on a fresh HotCRM load" acceptance item is not met yet. Putting the same provider above every protected frame is a decision the report hands back (one fetch for the whole shell, but Home then waits on `/auth/me/permissions`). #12700 remains open for it.

## Pins

`packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.navCanPermissions-12700.test.tsx` mounts the real `UnifiedSidebar` under the real `ExpressionProvider`, `MePermissionsProvider` (only its `fetcher`, the network, is mocked) and `MetadataProvider`. The gated entry is a `dashboard` entry, so the object-read prune (objectui#12109) cannot be what hides it:

- (a) member without read: gated entry absent, nothing reported;
- (b) member with read: shown;
- (c) while `/auth/me/permissions` is pending the provider withholds the whole shell (its existing loading posture, not one entry), the entry is absent, and it appears once the answer grants read; one request;
- (d) CONTROL: ungated entries are drawn for the member the gate hides from;
- no payload bound (the Home/Studio case): gated entry withheld, the rest drawn, one `app-shell:visible` line naming the missing permission data and the withholding consequence.

`packages/app-shell/src/providers/__tests__/navigationVisibility-12700.test.ts`: granted/denied answer silently; unbound withholds and reports once; another fault kind (unknown root) withholds; literals, an absent gate and a blank gate keep their answers; CONTROL: `evaluateVisibility` and `isObjectFieldVisible` stay fail-open on the same fault.

(e) CONTROL, the record page's own `can` gate: `currentUserCan-4421.render.test.tsx` passes unchanged.

Fifteen layout tests that stub the `ExpressionProvider` module now also stub `evaluateNavigationVisibility` with the stub they already used for `evaluateVisibility`.

### Ablation (one-shot, on the committed fix)

`useNavMemberGates` switched back to `evaluateVisibility` (mutation confirmed on disk: mutant marker 1, fix marker 0) → `UnifiedSidebar.navCanPermissions-12700.test.tsx`: 1 failed, 4 passed; the red one is the no-payload pin. (a)–(d) stay green under the ablation, which is the root-cause measurement above: inside an app the payload is bound and the gate never faulted. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, blob hash equal to HEAD's.

## Verification (head `3e7dfc0c7`)

- Closure build `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`: 28/28.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/react` and `@object-ui/app-shell` (both `tsconfig` and `tsconfig.test.json`): green after typing the spy.
- vitest, `--maxWorkers=1`, one area at a time: `app-shell/src/providers` + `hooks` + `chrome` 108 files / 918 tests passed; `app-shell/src/layout` 84 / 593 passed; `app-shell/src/console/__tests__` + two react diagnostic suites 33 / 277 passed; `react/src/utils` + the concealment diagnostic suite 7 / 82 passed; the rest of `app-shell/src/console` plus `views/__tests__/nav-*`: 676 tests passed, 0 failed, but the run hit its 560 s cap before printing a summary, so that slice is partly NOT MEASURED. Final targeted run on `3e7dfc0c7` (both new files, 4421, 12109 sidebar, 12426 landing): 5 files / 35 tests passed. Not run locally: the rest of `app-shell/src/views` and the full suite (CI).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 23 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors (`--format json`: 23 files). The config enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move the verdict on an untouched file.
- Pre-tsc battery, all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `test-path-roots`, `new-line-citations`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`.

## Acceptance notes

- A bare-string `visible` (not the served CEL envelope) takes the evaluator's legacy path, which answered `false` even for a granted member in the probe. Served navigation carries the envelope (the spec normalizes the authored string), so it is outside this card's surface. Noted, not filed.
